_readme: S395 SkyHawthorn, 2026-10-15. Read 2 (run 38752570705) found Monterey Peninsula's GE pages in its site map. Its degree pages name 'MPC General Education or Cal-GETC' (52 records) or 'Cal-GETC' (33) and print no GE units of their own. This read prints the pages that state each pattern's units, the way Cerritos's CGEC page states 24-28, so the reconcile step can cite the catalog's words. Three loads, no model call.

questions.mpc_ge: How many units the MPC General Education pattern requires, in the catalog's words.
questions.calgetc: How many units Cal-GETC requires, in the catalog's words.
questions.degree: How the catalog states the associate degree's 60 units and what fills them.
